_source: docs/design-bible.md: Trinkets, Consumables, Gear, Wondrous items, Boss trophies, Loot defaults. Names and effects as written; Meadow in a jar reworded per Loot defaults.
trinkets: A stub of tourist chalk that only draws arrows. They always point back the way you came.
A brass placard fragment reading "...ind the Shift."
A Pale Lodge contract tag, faded past reading, except under moonlight, where one name shows clearly.
A pressed flower from a pilgrim's offering. It smells like whoever you miss most.
A dented Archive survey beacon blinking a dead expedition's code. Caretaker-9 can look it up.
One boot. Its pair turns up in a later run, always one floor deeper.
A hex tile that clicks softly whenever it's set down, settling.
A shrine candle stub that relights itself once a day for 1 minute.
A tally stick notched to 41, then nothing.
A sliver of gate-glass. Held to the eye, it shows a sunlit meadow for one heartbeat.
A die blank on every face but one, which always lands facing down.
A key with no teeth. If the party ever finds the door with no keyhole, this opens it.
A Corky's coaster with a stranger's story scrawled on the back, unfinished.
A ball of red thread, knotted every 10 feet.
A pilgrim's hymn page. Humming it makes the nearest column hum back.
A punched stride ticket to a destination the Archive has no record of.
A jar of honey that tastes of rain.
A brass maze puzzle with no solution. Solving it anyway (DC 20 Intelligence) makes it an offering worth two rerolls.
A pilgrim's prayer card: "Let what is lost be found by someone."
Something you lost years ago, outside the Basalts. Thils returns it, a little worn.

consumables.name: Healing potion
consumables.effect: A Potion of Healing of the floor's grade: common Healing, uncommon Greater, rare Superior, very rare and up Supreme.

consumables.name: Pilgrim's wax
consumables.effect: Light it as a Bonus Action. For 1 minute, you and allies within 10 ft have advantage on saves against traps and room tricks.

consumables.name: Tourist's chalk
consumables.effect: Draw an arrow on a wall. You learn which exit leads on, and the arrow keeps pointing there for 1 hour.

consumables.name: Vial of upward dew
consumables.effect: Drink it: for 10 minutes you can walk on walls and ceilings, and you can choose to fall upward.

consumables.name: Gate-glass splinter
consumables.effect: Throw it at a creature within 30 ft: Charisma save or it's teleported up to 15 ft to a space you choose.

consumables.name: Paradise honey
consumables.effect: Eat it as a Bonus Action: gain 5 × PB temp HP, and you can't be Frightened while they last.

consumables.name: Echo phial
consumables.effect: Uncork it as a Bonus Action: your next hit before the end of your next turn repeats as an echo for half its damage, as force.

consumables.name: Snap-pillar charge
consumables.effect: A disarmed room trick. As an action, arm it in an adjacent space; it triggers as a Snap-Pillar on the next enemy to step there.

consumables.name: Lodge contract ink
consumables.effect: Write a creature's name on any tag as a Bonus Action. For 1 minute, your attacks against it deal +PB damage.

consumables.name: Capped static vent
consumables.effect: Throw it up to 30 ft: creatures within 10 ft make a Constitution save or take PB d6 lightning damage and lose Reactions until their next turn.

consumables.name: Thils's lucky pip
consumables.effect: A single die face. Spend it to reroll one d20 test after you see the result.

consumables.name: Stride spark
consumables.effect: Crush it as a Bonus Action to teleport 30 ft, or crush it before a stride roll to add +PB to the roll.

gear.name: Lodge hunting blade
gear.property: Your first hit against a creature that hasn't acted yet this combat deals +1d6 damage.

gear.name: Columnbreaker
gear.property: Double damage to objects and structures. Hitting a column or pillar can topple it onto a creature within 10 ft: Dexterity save or PB d6 bludgeoning damage and Prone.

gear.name: Ricochet sling
gear.property: Once per turn, when you miss, the shot bounces: attack another creature within 10 ft of the first.

gear.name: Cable-lash
gear.property: Reach 15 ft. As a Bonus Action, swing on it up to 15 ft to a column, cable or ledge you can see.

gear.name: Hymn-tuned glaive
gear.property: On a hit, the weapon hums: the next ally to attack that target before your next turn adds 1d4 to the roll.

gear.name: Gate-glass edge
gear.property: Deals force damage instead of its normal type when you choose. When drawn, its light shows a meadow.

gear.name: Wardstone plate
gear.property: When an effect would push, pull or knock you Prone, you can use your Reaction to stay put.

gear.name: Surveyor's coat
gear.property: Advantage on checks to spot traps, room tricks and false walls.

gear.name: Echo-stitched leathers
gear.property: When an attack misses you, you can use your Reaction to move 5 ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

gear.name: Choir shield
gear.property: When you take the Dodge action, allies within 5 ft of you have half cover.

gear.name: Lodestone shield
gear.property: You ignore magnetic pulls like the Magnetic Floor. Once per day, as an action, pull a metal weapon from a creature within 10 ft (Strength save or it lands at your feet).

gear.name: Meadowlight breastplate
gear.property: While Bloodied, you shed golden light in a 10 ft radius and have advantage on Death Saving Throws.

common.name: Wayward compass
common.effect: Points to the last thing you lost.

common.name: Pilgrim's bell
common.effect: Chimes softly when you come within 10 ft of an armed trap or room trick, without showing where.

common.name: "Ask Me About the Shift" pin
common.effect: Locals of the Basalts treat the wearer as a fellow pilgrim.

common.name: Self-humming hymnal
common.effect: Quietly plays any hymn you've heard once, up to 1 hour a day.

common.name: Meadow locket
common.effect: Opening it smells of rain and honey. Once per day, open it to end the Frightened condition on yourself.

common.name: Echo spool
common.effect: Records 6 seconds of sound and replays it on command.

common.name: Hourglass that falls up
common.effect: Its sand runs upward and keeps exact time on any plane. Caretaker-9 finds it deeply annoying.

common.name: Lost-and-found pouch
common.effect: Anything that once sat in the pouch and is then lost reappears in it at the next dawn, once per item.

uncommon.name: Gamewright's dice
uncommon.effect: Twice per day, when a creature within 30 ft makes a d20 test, roll 1d6 and add it to or subtract it from the roll.

uncommon.name: Survey beacon
uncommon.effect: Plant it as an action. Within 1 mile, you always know its direction. Once per day, it sends a 25-word message to your Stride Anchor with no delay.

uncommon.name: Gate-glass monocle
uncommon.effect: Once per day, as a Bonus Action, see invisible creatures and objects within 30 ft through it for 1 minute.

uncommon.name: Rune-pair tiles
uncommon.effect: Once per day, set both tiles down up to 60 ft apart. For 1 hour, a creature on one can spend 5 ft of movement to teleport to the other, once per round.

uncommon.name: Cloak of the unregarded
uncommon.effect: You can Hide while only lightly obscured, as long as no creature is looking directly at you.

uncommon.name: Paradise seed
uncommon.effect: Plant it and it grows overnight into a shrub with 1d4 + PB golden berries. Each restores 1 HP and feeds a creature for a day. The shrub leaves a new seed after 7 days.

uncommon.name: Collector's loupe
uncommon.effect: Touch a magic item through it to identify it, learn its value in credits, and learn the name of the last person who lost it.

uncommon.name: Ball of red thread
uncommon.effect: Tie it off at a doorway. While you hold the ball, you always know the way back, and once per day you can teleport to that doorway as an action if it's within 120 ft.

rare.name: Wardstone heart
rare.effect: Once per day, as an action, it unfolds into a Column Sentinel (Gargoyle stat block) that obeys you for 1 hour.

rare.name: Contract seal
rare.effect: Once per day, as a Bonus Action, seal a contract on a creature you can see. For 1 minute, you score critical hits against it on a 19 or 20, and you know its location while it's within 1 mile.

rare.name: Anchoring spike
rare.effect: Once per day, drive it into the ground as an action. For 1 minute, creatures within 30 ft can't be teleported, pushed or pulled against their will.

rare.name: Folded room
rare.effect: A hex tile that unfolds into a 20 ft hexagonal room with one door, for up to 8 hours a day (as Leomund's Tiny Hut, but solid). It won't unfold in the Basalts: Thils allows no rooms he didn't build.

rare.name: Echo locket
rare.effect: Once per day, when you drop to 0 HP, an echo takes your place: you drop to 1 HP instead and are Invisible until the start of your next turn.

rare.name: Pressed bookmark
rare.effect: When you cast a healing spell, one target also ends the Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned condition.

rare.name: Dead surveyor's log
rare.effect: Once per day, ask it a yes-or-no question about the place you're in. The answer writes itself in a dead surveyor's hand.

rare.name: Doorwright's calipers
rare.effect: Once per day, measure a doorway you're touching and one you touched in the last 24 hours within 500 ft. For 1 minute, they're linked as a two-way portal.

very-rare.name: The thousandth key
very-rare.effect: Once per day, turn it in any door. For 1 minute, the door opens onto any door you've passed through on this plane.

very-rare.name: Pilgrim-saint's censer
very-rare.effect: Once per day, swing it as an action to fill a 30 ft radius with golden smoke for 1 minute. Allies starting a turn in it regain PB HP, and enemies starting a turn in it take PB necrotic damage.

very-rare.name: Collector's satchel
very-rare.effect: Works as a Bag of Holding. Once per day, reach in to find one consumable you used up since the last dawn.

very-rare.name: Duelist's echo mask
very-rare.effect: Once per day, as a Bonus Action, call a past strider's echo for 1 minute. It shares your AC and attack bonus, has 5 × PB HP, and makes one weapon attack whenever you take the Attack action.

very-rare.name: Gate-glass eye
very-rare.effect: You have Truesight to 30 ft, and you always know the way out of any maze or labyrinth you're in, except Thils's own.

very-rare.name: Hourglass of the Shift
very-rare.effect: Once per day, as a Reaction at the start of another creature's turn, swap two creatures you can see within 60 ft (Charisma save for an unwilling creature).

legendary.name: Thils's cast-off die
legendary.effect: A d20 the god lost in a game. Once per day, replace any d20 roll you can see with a 20 or a 1.

legendary.name: Meadow in a jar
legendary.effect: A living patch of a sunlit meadow, sealed. Once per day, open it for 1 minute: allies within 30 ft regain 10 HP at the start of each turn, and the first time each would drop to 0 HP, they drop to 1 instead.

legendary.name: Ring of many exits
legendary.effect: Cast Dimension Door at will, as long as you leave from and arrive at a doorway, archway or other opening.

legendary.name: First Expedition's stride compass
legendary.effect: When you stride, you can choose your stride roll's result instead of rolling. Once per day, it points to the nearest stride gate or tear on your plane.

trophies.name: Warden's cracked lens
trophies.effect: Once per day, as an action, hold it up: a creature within 30 ft that can see it makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed for 1 minute, walking toward a golden meadow only it can see. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

trophies.name: Hollow pipe
trophies.effect: 3 charges, regained at dawn. As an action, spend 1 to blast a 15 ft cone: Constitution save or PB d6 thunder damage and pushed 10 ft, half damage and no push on a success.

trophies.name: Gilded tether
trophies.effect: Once per day, as a Bonus Action, tether a creature within 30 ft to a column or object (Dexterity save). For 1 minute, it can't move more than 15 ft from that point.

trophies.name: Twin-swap bands
trophies.effect: A pair of bracers for two wearers. Once per round, as a Bonus Action, either wearer can swap places with the other within 60 ft.

trophies.name: Quill's longshot scope
trophies.effect: Fits any ranged weapon. Normal range doubles, and your hits deal +PB damage to the Bloodied creature with the lowest HP you can see.

trophies.name: Spinner's spool
trophies.effect: As a Bonus Action, string a glowing cable between two points within 60 ft (up to 2 at once, 1 minute each). Allies touching one can teleport 15 ft along it as part of their move, and enemies crossing it take PB d4 lightning damage.

trophies.name: Core shard
trophies.effect: Once per day, as an action, open a 10 ft pool of raw stride energy within 60 ft for 1 minute. It's difficult terrain, and creatures ending a turn in it make a Strength save or are Restrained.

trophies.name: Tenth Stride pauldron
trophies.effect: Switch stance as a Bonus Action. Phalanx: ranged attacks that miss you rebound at the attacker. Stampede: +10 ft speed, and you can move through hostile creatures' spaces (Strength save or Prone).

trophies.name: Hydra prism
trophies.effect: When a ray, line or beam spell targets or includes you, use your Reaction to roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you're unaffected and it strikes another creature you choose within 30 ft.

trophies.name: Seamless veil
trophies.effect: Once per day, for 1 minute, creatures looking at you have disadvantage on attacks against you. A creature can avert its eyes to attack normally, but is Blinded to you until its next turn.

trophies.name: Three black angles
trophies.effect: Three polyhedrons orbit you. Once per day, for 1 minute, you take half damage from any creature that moved closer to you this turn.

trophies.name: Reliquary lock
trophies.effect: 2 charges, regained at dawn. Spend 1 to cast Dispel Magic at 6th level. A creature that loses an effect this way takes PB d8 necrotic damage.

trophies.name: Inverted bloom
trophies.effect: While you hold it, allies within 10 ft regain PB HP at the start of their turns. Once per day, as an action, release Paradise Spores in a 30 ft cone: Wisdom save or Charmed for 1 minute, spending each turn walking toward you.

trophies.name: Sun-eater's antler
trophies.effect: 3 charges, regained at dawn. As a Bonus Action, spend 1 to devour a light source or one magical effect within 60 ft (as Dispel Magic at 9th level) and regain 5 × PB HP.

trophies.name: Gatewright's three keys
trophies.effect: Once per day, for 1 minute, open three portals within 60 ft. Your attacks and spells can come from any portal, and creatures can step from one portal to another.
